structured_execution.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts (codex-cli 0.147.0, darwin): thread/started, turn/started, item/started, item/completed, thread/tokenUsage/updated, error and turn/completed observed on real sessions and normalized; unknown methods and fields are preserved as raw events

owned_session_identity.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: thread/start returns a stable thread id reused by every later request, notification and resume

observed_cancellation.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: turn/interrupt ended a running shell loop and the receipt reports 'observed' only after turn/completed with status interrupted; shutdown escalates SIGTERM then SIGKILL against the owned process group and reports the observed group state

resume_session.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: a thread was resumed by id in a second app-server process after the first was terminated and answered from the earlier turn's history. Resuming a thread with no completed turn fails with -32600 'no rollout found'

active_turn_delivery.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: turn/steer with expectedTurnId accepted mid-turn, receipt state submitted_to_active_turn; a delivery with no active turn is queued and flushed into the next turn/start input

sandbox_workspace_write.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts (FR042 boundary): workspace-write with explicit writableRoots plus excludeSlashTmp and excludeTmpdirEnvVar. Writes inside the granted root succeed; writes to a sibling workspace, /tmp and $TMPDIR are denied with 'Operation not permitted'; network denied. Checked through command/exec and through a model-driven turn. Codex's own workspaceWrite default leaves /tmp and $TMPDIR writable, so both exclusions are always set by this adapter

model_selection.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: model/list reports available ids and -c model="<id>" is reflected in the thread/start response and used by the turn

effort_selection.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: model/list reports supported reasoning efforts per model and -c model_reasoning_effort="<value>" is reflected in the thread/start response; thread/start has no effort parameter in this protocol version

token_usage_report.evidence: WP03 tests/adapters/codex/real-runtime.test.ts: thread/tokenUsage/updated reports input, cached input, output and reasoning token counts per turn

cost_report.evidence: WP03 docs/runtime-codex.md: the app server reports no currency-cost field at all; cost must be labelled unavailable, never zero
